advance_prep.instruction: Soak whole moong, drain before blending

steps.text: Blend soaked moong with chilli, cumin and salt into a pourable batter.
Cook 4 thin chillas (about 18 cm) on a hot non-stick pan, 2 minutes a side.
steps.cue: Bubbles appear across the surface, the edges lift and the underside is golden. Flip once, when the top is no longer shiny.
steps.tip: Pour the batter in the centre and spread it quickly in a spiral. A hot pan, lightly greased, stops sticking.

steps.text: Fill with crumbled paneer, onion and coriander, fold.
